title: Detection of Microdeletions in the Azoospermia Factor (AZF) Regions in Infertile Male Patients
brief_summary: In this prospective study, we used Multiplex ligation-dependent probe amplification and next-generation sequencing technology to detect AZF microdeletion types accurately in selected genetic locus, and made correlation analysis with clinical treatment results.
study_population: Male patients diagnosed with azoospermia and severe oligozoospermia.
